# Coldi.ai

> Coldi is a fully managed voice AI service that automates inbound and outbound phone calls for fintech: trading platforms, insurance brokers, debt collection and digital banking.

Coldi builds, runs and continuously optimizes AI voice agents for financial companies. The agents qualify leads, follow up on KYC and verification, handle policy renewals, collect payments and promises to pay, re-engage dormant accounts, and answer inbound customer calls. Agents follow the client's business rules and scripts and integrate with existing telephony, CRM and calendar systems. Coldi is a managed service, not a telephone carrier, VoIP provider or call-center software.

## Solutions
- [Solutions](https://coldi.ai/solutions): Inbound and outbound AI calling, how the managed service works.
- [Use cases](https://coldi.ai/use-cases): Examples of call workflows by industry.

## Industries
- [Industries overview](https://coldi.ai/industries): Verticals Coldi serves.
- [Trading platforms](https://coldi.ai/industries/trading-platforms-brokers): KYC follow-ups, onboarding calls, reactivation of dormant accounts.
- [Insurance brokers](https://coldi.ai/industries/insurance): Policy renewals, lead qualification, claims follow-up.
- [Debt collection](https://coldi.ai/industries/debt-collection): Payment reminders, promise-to-pay plans, compliant outbound calling.
- [Digital banking](https://coldi.ai/industries/digital-banking-payments): Inbound support and customer follow-ups.
